items.question: How can a mind fixed on that remain uncut even when the body is being severed?
premises: The body may be in the process of being cut.
A mind fixed on that is oriented away from bodily injury.
That orientation prevents the cutting from affecting the mind.
items.inference: A mind fixed on that is not severed even as the body undergoes cutting.
uncertainties: The precise referent of that remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Just as one whose mind is fixed on that is not cut when the body is being cut, so too is that mind unaffected.
